## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the suggested feature.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of how you envision this feature working.

## Safety & Privacy Considerations
- Does this maintain strictly local processing (`127.0.0.1`)?
- Does this respect approved root sandboxing?
- Does this require explicit user confirmation before any mutation?

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
